description: Creates a new environmental record and associates it with the specified incident.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier of the incident to associate this environmental record with. Required on create.

environmental_type_id.description: Unique identifier of the environmental type classifying this record. Retrieve valid IDs from GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/incidents/environmental_types.

description.description: Description of event in Rich Text format

estimated_cost_impact.description: Estimated monetary cost impact of this environmental event.

quantity_unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure for the "quantity" field (19 possible values)

affected_company_id.description: Unique identifier of the vendor company affected by this environmental event.

managed_equipment_id.description: Unique identifier of the managed equipment involved in this environmental event.

work_activity_id.description: Unique identifier of the work activity during which this environmental event occurred.

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
